5198.reason: Some blue herons migrate means there exists an x that is a heron, blue, and migrates: existential conjunction, not a conditional or universal.

5199.reason: Some folks are lucky is an existential claim that something is both a folk and lucky; B/C name one individual and D universalizes both predicates.

5202.reason: P(even)=1/2 on a d20, so exactly 2 of 4 is C(4,2)*(1/2)^4 = 6/16 = 3/8.

5204.reason: The opening claim is what the rest supports: the monster’s huge gains and outweighed sacrifices explain why utilitarianism is embarrassed.

5205.reason: Parallel spins force an antisymmetric spatial wavefunction, so electrons stay farther apart and repulsion drops; that exchange effect comes from the Pauli principle.
